designAdvisory.rationale: A bounded immutable report basis can avoid reconstructing the same canonical document for every report page. At the qualified8f producer each page request recomputes the complete retained document snapshot, so a fresh authenticated first-page response can serve as a requalification signal under that exact producer/callback contract. The consumer cannot infer authentication or currentness merely from matching hashes.

prediction.assumptions: One fresh qualification page per continuation, unchanged report page count and no invalidation/fallback. Page-count/metadata overhead can change the actual result.

requiredControls.requirement: Every enabled continuation must invoke the authenticated owner callback before cached content is returned, including replayed cursors. A cache key/callerBinding/snapshot is not authentication. Refusal, revoked session, owner/actor change or transport failure must return no cached report text.
requiredControls.unresolvedAssumption: The current callback type alone does not prove fresh authentication. The selected owner adapter must establish that it revalidates the current caller and actually executes the canonical retained query for each probe, without serving a stale cached page as authorization.
requiredControls.validation: Pause an in-flight qualification and revoke/rotate the actor/session; test cross-owner/cross-actor and A-to-B-to-A changes. Require appropriate owner authorization through the last relevant asynchronous boundary. No native enablement until that owner contract is qualified.

requiredControls.topic: Full-basis integrity plus qualified first-page identity
requiredControls.requirement: Construct a reusable basis only after the canonical strict reader exhausts every page and verifies the final document digest. A continuation probe must validate the canonical reply union, exact selector, offset0, page configuration and original snapshot/caller binding, and compare relevant metadata and a canonical first-page fragment fingerprint to the verified basis.
requiredControls.importantDetail: Use the same source-reader request parameters as the initial canonical read: limit250/maxBytes65536. callerBinding includes request parameters, so report-output budgets or query defaults100 must not silently substitute. Do not blindly compare delivery timestamps or process-specific continuation signatures as semantic identity.
requiredControls.limit: Matching a first-page hash field cannot independently prove unseen content is fresh if the callback does not honor the pinned producer contract. Unsupported adapters must remain stateless or refuse reuse.

requiredControls.requirement: Bind each basis to service instance, canonical source selection, trusted caller binding, complete selector including date/group/student, report format/renderer identity, reportHash and output pagination parameters. Clone caller inputs before yielding. Validate offset/progress and refuse foreign, missing, stale or changed basis references.
requiredControls.validation: Wrong selector, source revision, format, caller, report budget/limit, forged offset, repeated cursor, restart and another service instance must not disclose another basis or silently skip lines. Preserve explicit same-snapshot replay semantics.

requiredControls.topic: Currentness and clocks are not refreshed by reuse
requiredControls.requirement: Preserve original source-observed/verified/recorded/teacher-reported and basis-retrieval timestamps. Add a separately labelled retained-snapshot qualification time if needed; never rewrite old clocks as current source acquisition.
requiredControls.accounting: Separate pages used to build the basis from pages read by the current continuation. Keeping canonicalPagesConsumed=N without explaining reuse would misleadingly imply N fresh reads for a one-page qualification.
requiredControls.validation: Same snapshot with new retrieval time, changed verification clock, teacher correction, cancellation/replacement, grade/attempt/issuance revision and metadata/coverage drift must have the predeclared refusal/invalidation behavior.

requiredControls.requirement: Keep the option disabled by default and enable it only through owner-local service composition, never a tool argument or global/native setting. Predeclare finite entry-count, TTL and serialized-basis byte limits with a monotonic expiry basis. Retain only the immutable report/provenance/fingerprint material required by the design.
requiredControls.custody: Deep-copy/freeze retained metadata and line arrays; do not retain mutable source callback objects, credentials, sessions, full private stores or repository files. Eviction/disposal and logout/refusal purge behavior must be explicit. Byte budgets are not RSS or secure-erasure guarantees.
requiredControls.validation: Capacity pressure, large Unicode/escaped text, concurrent creation, expiry, eviction and instance disposal must remain bounded. Real-data retention policy requires separate source-owner qualification before activation.

requiredControls.topic: No implicit fallback or stale disclosure
requiredControls.requirement: On source-module drift, snapshot/caller mismatch, malformed/refused probe, expired/evicted/missing basis or unsupported owner-auth guarantees, refuse before releasing cached content. Any full-reconstruction fallback must be explicitly selected, preserve coverage and be counted; it must not bypass refusal or trigger acquisition/business effects.
requiredControls.validation: Do not relabel a stale basis as a new snapshot or silently switch to a new report mid-cursor. Concurrency tests must prove one immutable report basis is used throughout each result.

requiredControls.topic: Output and semantic quality gates stay mandatory
requiredControls.requirement: Preserve all four007 repairs, strict bounded SDK input errors, the actual complete CallToolResult cap and requested report budget, source-owned hierarchy/stages/clocks, unknown-versus-pending semantics, all lines and explicit continuation.
requiredControls.validation: Compare normalized full report lines/reportHash and source/teacher metadata against the stateless control. Predeclare exactly which delivery-time/accounting fields may differ. Measure JSON-RPC frame bytes separately; do not infer a universal512KiB frame cap.

requiredControls.requirement: Before a candidate, retain the planned bounded Work Input/preflight, independent quality gates, two-attempt/time limit, exact source identities and absolute canonical-fetch reduction criterion using existing common helpers. Evaluate efficiency only after quality passes.
requiredControls.validation: Use paired warm-hit and miss/drift/expiry cases with equal outputs or explicitly expected equivalent refusals. Record real page/fetch counts, cache bytes and evictions.
